name: Trickplayer
description: Plex/Jellyfin player as synced thumbnails + subs

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to Plex to sign in, and to your own Plex or Jellyfin server (plex.direct or tailscale ts.net) to download trick-play frames and subtitles.

notes: Plex episodes whose subtitles are inside the video file now play. The first play reads the subtitles out through your server, which takes a few seconds to a minute or so; after that they load at once.

Every episode is now listed, with badges showing what will play: SUBS in green plays straight away, amber reads its subtitles from the file on first play, and a crossed-out SUBS or IMG shows what an episode is missing.
Long subtitle lines are no longer cut off on the glasses. Lines are measured to fit, and a long subtitle is split across screens instead of losing its last lines.
Jellyfin items with only image-based subtitles are now shown as missing subtitles instead of failing when played.
